Neutral standing pose on all four legs, legs straight and apart, all four paws visible on one ground line, tail held out behind and slightly down, not crossing the body. Same size and scale in every view. Flat, even, shadowless studio light: no cast shadows, no ground shadow, no rim light, no orange fringe. Plain uniform light grey background. No text, no numbers, no labels, no grid lines. Keep his identity exactly: the black eye mask with white brows and muzzle, the ringed tail with dark brown and tan bands, grey-brown fur with a lighter tan underside, dark brown legs and paws, his round chubby proportions and rounded ears. Soft painterly storybook illustration style with fine fur texture.

parameters.prompt: The attached images are all the same raccoon character, Stevie: the first is his whole sprite sheet and the others are single frames from it. Draw a clean character turnaround of exactly this character for 3D modelling, keeping his identity above all. His identity: a ROUND, HUNCHED, CHUBBY body, the back arched high into a dome so the body is almost a ball, the head held low and forward at the front of the dome, short stocky legs; a BIG, very FLUFFY, thick tail nearly as wide as his body, with bold alternating dark-brown and tan rings; the black eye mask, white brows and white muzzle, round dark glossy eyes with a soft friendly look, small rounded ears with pale rims; warm grey-brown fluffy fur with a lighter tan underside, dark brown paws. Soft painterly storybook illustration finish, the same as the sprite sheet. Do NOT make him lean, long-bodied, upright or naturalistic, and do NOT give him a thin tail. Layout: four full-body views in one 2x2 grid, each centred in its own quarter with a wide margin: top-left FRONT view (facing the viewer), top-right THREE-QUARTER front view (facing front-left), bottom-left SIDE profile (facing left), bottom-right BACK view. Neutral standing pose on all four legs, all four paws on one ground line, tail curving out behind, not crossing the body. Same size in every view. Flat, even, shadowless light: no cast shadow, no ground shadow, no rim light, no orange fringe. Plain uniform light grey background. No text, no numbers, no labels, no grid lines.

calls.costBasis: AI Gateway credit balance before and after the call
